name: ceramics-webapp
description: The customer-facing storefront and admin console SPA: product browsing/search/filter, product detail, cart, sign-in-gated checkout, order confirmation, and order history for Shoppers; a role-gated catalog and order management console for the Store Admin. Talks only to ceramics-api and Thunder; holds no payment or email credentials.

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Ceramics API for product catalog, cart, checkout, order history, and (for the Store Admin role) catalog and order management.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs Shoppers and the Store Admin in via Thunder SSO (OIDC + PKCE) and provides the access token attached to every ceramics-api call.
